name: Mezan: Accounting & Sales
subtitle: Sell, collect, check stock
promotionalText: The phone companion to your company's Mezan account: your company's figures, sales invoices, collections, stock, attendance and approvals, in Arabic and English.
description:
Mezan is the phone app for companies that run their books on Mezan, the Arabic-first accounting and business-management system. Your company's administrator creates your account; you sign in with your company code, your work email and a six-digit PIN.

What you can do:
• Overview — cash, receivables, payables and net profit from your company's ledger, as your permissions allow.
• Sell — create a sales invoice or a quotation for a customer, pick items from your company's catalogue, and confirm it.
• Collect — record a collection voucher from a customer and allocate it to an open invoice.
• Customers — search your customers and see their phone, tax number, credit limit and payment terms.
• Stock — find an item by name or code, or scan its barcode with the camera, and see on-hand, reserved and available quantities per warehouse.
• Clock in and out — record attendance against the server's clock, with a photo when your company requires one.
• Approvals — approve or reject the requests waiting for you.

Built for how Egyptian businesses work:
• Arabic first, right to left, with a full English interface.
• Light and dark appearance.
• Every figure comes from your company's own ledger; documents you create post through the same rules as on the desktop.
• Recently viewed figures stay readable without a connection; creating a document needs one.

Mezan is sold to companies, not to individuals. The app does not create accounts; ask your company's administrator for access.
